note: Fixed copy spoken by VESTA, keyed by a step's 'say'. Tagged VESTA · interpretation on screen. The lines point at the quote and never state physics.

lines.standby: Earth is up to 20 minutes away. Press run.
lines.S1: Alarm. I am treating it as real.
lines.S2: Fans off. The reason is in the quote.
lines.S3: Masks before investigation. The flame shape is a separate finding.
lines.S4: Power off first. This one is ISS practice, not an experiment.
lines.S5: Careful where you aim. Read the quote.
lines.S6: I see no flame. The CO reading is still high. We are not done.
lines.S7: This material is in the tables. Read the rows before you trust them.
lines.S8: There is a source for this one. Read the quote first.
lines.no_source: No verified finding for this. I will not guess. The ISS fallback has limits.
lines.no_protocol: No verified finding and no verified protocol line. This decision is the crew's.
lines.end: Eight decisions made. At the maximum delay, Earth has only now heard the alarm.
lines.end_other: The log is complete. Every decision keeps its source and its evidence limit.
lines.user_file: Your telemetry, the same officer. Every step still needs its source.
lines.standby_no_delay: The delay has no verified source. Press run to inspect the on-board decisions.

si_provenance.activity: SI-assisted VESTA authorship and deterministic processing; attributed NASA quotations remain source text.

source_boundary.nasa: Verbatim NASA quote fields and original PSI raw table cells are NASA source content, not SI-generated evidence. Table transcriptions retain source-file and row references; this is not a claim that every exported file is byte-identical to a NASA download.
source_boundary.vesta: Claims, summaries, rules, titles, normalizations, inferred conditions, rankings, coverage labels and scripted telemetry/decisions are VESTA interpretations or processing authored with SI assistance. Quote gates verify text matching, not scientific correctness. Deterministic runtime computation does not call an SI model.
source_boundary.imagery: Original NASA photographs and mosaics retain their NASA/partner credits, not an SI-generation watermark. Shader flames, smoke, geometry and reconstructed lighting are SI-assisted VESTA illustrations, not NASA observations.
source_boundary.nasa_notice: NASA has not reviewed or endorsed VESTA's SI-assisted interpretations and is not responsible for their accuracy.
